Package neqsim.thermo.component

Class HenryWaterReferencePoint

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.component.HenryWaterReferencePoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public final class HenryWaterReferencePoint extends Object implements Serializable, Cloneable
Immutable, reference-temperature-only Henry datum for a neutral solute in water.

The stored quantity is the solubility convention Hsbp = molality / partial pressure in mol/(kg atm). The converted volatility Hm = partial pressure / molality is in bar kg/mol. It is not the mole-fraction volatility Hx. No temperature correlation is implied by a reference point.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
